_style: Wide 16:9 illustration for a horror fairy tale, unsettling and ominous. Keep everything important in the upper two thirds of the picture; the bottom fifth is dark, quiet ground with nothing in it. Dark painterly digital oil painting, visible thick brushstrokes, heavy chiaroscuro, limited palette of soot black, bone white, rust red, swamp green, candle amber, cold blue. Slavic folk horror in the manner of 19th-century Russian painting (Vasnetsov, Vrubel, Bilibin). Grim, grounded, realistic anatomy, every living figure has two arms and two legs. No text, no letters, no watermark, no signature, no frame, no modern objects.
pro_1: Koschei the Deathless, a withered ancient skeletal king in a black iron crown, dry skin stretched over bone, tattered dark royal robes, stands on a cliff at night and tears the sky apart with both hands like the cloth of a shroud; through the ragged rent pour cold blue light and a swarm of small black crawling and winged shapes; far below lies a tiny sleeping Slavic village.
pro_2: inside a Slavic peasant hut at grey dawn: a family sits motionless at the table with open staring eyes and dark graveyard earth spilling from their mouths onto the boards, bowls of earth before them; in the open doorway behind them stands a pale dead man in a burial shirt, smiling, one hand still raised from knocking.
pro_3: the last stockade at night: a wall of sharpened logs with a gate, hollow-eyed sleepless peasants feeding the beams of their own huts into a great bonfire, two guards with spears; beyond the open gate a narrow path runs into an enormous black spruce forest whose opening looks like a throat, under a blood-red sky.
again: a lone traveller in a dark hooded cloak, seen from behind, stands in the open gate of a log stockade in cold dawn mist and looks at a narrow path that leads into a black forest; the trees lean in over the path like a waiting mouth; a guard's brazier burns low beside the gate.
act2: seen from the edge of a dark forest: an old graveyard of leaning wooden crosses where every grave has been dug open from below, earth thrown outward, and beyond it a silent Slavic village of log huts with closed shutters and thick greasy smoke rising from the chimneys, under a sickly yellow sky; not a single person anywhere.
act3: the edge of the world: the ground ends as if bitten off, and far below runs a black burning river; a red-hot iron bridge hung with glowing chains crosses it, with charred remains of armour and bones fused to its railings; on the far shore the sky hangs upside down, with inverted clouds and dead trees growing downward; a small cloaked traveller stands at the near end of the bridge.
act4: a towering black gate of riveted iron and bone in a huge wall, standing slightly ajar, with cold blue light and a glint of old gold showing through the gap; on both sides rows of rusted helmets on wooden stakes, and in the eye slits of a few helmets a pale eye looks out; one bare, freshly sharpened stake stands in front; a small cloaked traveller stands before the gate.
fall_forest_1: deep in an ancient forest a fallen traveller lies on thick moss while thin roots creep over his arms and neck and press into his skin like veins; above him looms the Leshy, a huge old forest spirit of bark, moss and antlers with hollow eyes, bending low to sniff at him; sick green twilight.
fall_forest_2: dawn at the gate of a log stockade: an unconscious traveller lies on the ground before the gate, slick with slime, covered in spruce needles, with pale mushrooms and white fungus threads growing in his hair and on his clothes; two sentries with spears stand over him and stare at his chest; behind them the forest path, smooth and untouched.
fall_village_1: inside a peasant log hut at night: a table laid with a bowl of dark earth and pale worms, a neatly made bed, and a dead peasant family seated at the table, grey skin, lipless mouths with bared teeth stretched like smiles, turned towards the viewer and gesturing at an empty place set with a spoon; through the small window a wooden bell tower is seen.
fall_village_2: a traveller on his hands and knees beside a small campfire inside a log stockade at night, spitting out dark earth onto the ground, horror on his face; far away over the top of the wall, tiny on the horizon under a yellow moon, stands the wooden bell tower of a dead village.
fall_nav_1: the grey ash shore of a black river in the underworld under a sky that hangs upside down; a gaunt half-transparent traveller stands at the water's edge and looks at his own hands, which are fading to bare bone; dozens of small pale lights drift above the water like souls, and among them one burns brighter and angrier, amber.
fall_nav_2: noon at the gate of a log stockade: a pale traveller stands in full sunlight and casts no shadow at all, while the gate posts, a sentry and his spear all cast long sharp shadows across the ground; a dog cowers away from the traveller with its tail between its legs; the sentry stares at the bare ground at his feet.
fall_koschei_1: Koschei the Deathless, a withered skeletal king in a black iron crown, lounges on a high black throne of iron and skulls in a dark vault, lazily holding up one bony hand and bending a finger as if counting; the floor before him is heaped with what looks like gold but is thousands of yellowed human teeth; a beaten traveller crawls towards the throne across them.
fall_koschei_2: in a dark vault a great dead oak grows through the floor, and in its branches hangs an open iron-bound chest wrapped in chains; skeletal hands in ragged royal sleeves lower into it a small dim warm ember wrapped in a rag; far off through the open door of the hall a small stooped figure walks away along a line of footprints in grey ash.
win_dawn_1: Koschei the Deathless on his black throne falls apart: the dry skin of his raised hands peels away in long ribbons with nothing beneath, grey ash pours from his open mouth and down his robes; a small broken iron needle lies on the step before him; the stone vault above splits open and harsh dawn light pours through the crack.
win_dawn_2: close view by candlelight in a log hut: an old healer woman's hands with small iron tweezers draw a thin iron splinter shaped like a needle with an eye out of the swollen, inflamed palm of a man's hand; the splinter is bent as if wriggling; a clay bowl of murky water and a stained rag beside them on the table.
win_throne_1: a traveller in a dark cloak stands before an empty black throne of iron and skulls and holds a small iron needle on his open palm, staring at it; dark veins spread up his neck and face, and thin black smoke leaks from the corner of his mouth; on the floor by the throne lie a heap of grey ash and a fallen black iron crown.
win_throne_2: the same traveller now sits on the black throne of iron and skulls, wearing the black iron crown, withered and pale, and the iron of the throne has grown over his forearms and legs like roots, fusing him to it; his mouth hangs slightly open, hungry; far down the dark hall, in a distant bright doorway, stand the small silhouettes of four new heroes with a torch.
win_scarred_1: dawn at the mouth of a dark cave that leads out of the underworld: three weary wounded travellers come out into the light, one leaning on another, one with an arm that ends in a bandaged stump at the elbow, and one carries an empty cloak; behind them in the dark of the cave pale hands reach out after them.
win_scarred_2: three ancient peasant women in headscarves sit on a bench by the wall of a log stockade, laughing with toothless mouths, one of them pointing a crooked finger towards a path into the black forest; a scarred traveller with a bandaged stump of an arm stands beside them and looks down that path; overcast evening.
win_circle_1: in a dark vault an iron-bound chest stands open in the branches of a great dead oak, its chains hanging loose; inside the chest there is only a round old mirror, and in the mirror is the hooded traveller's own face, but withered, dry and ancient like a mummy's; beside him stands Koschei the Deathless, withered in the same way, one bony hand resting on the lid.
win_circle_2: inside a log hut at dawn: a worn leather belt with a sheathed knife hangs on an iron nail in the wall, lit by a shaft of light from a small window, and a hand with grey ash under its fingernails reaches for it; through the open door beyond are seen the gate of the stockade and the path into the forest, dark as an open mouth.
secret_1: the same forest edge by night as the prologue: a small campfire, and beside it, where the old storyteller sat, a young peasant lad with a traveller's linen bag over his shoulder, laughing at a tale; behind his back, out of the fog between the trees, many long pale thin hands reach slowly towards him.
secret_2: a village graveyard at dusk under the first snow: crooked wooden crosses, and on the nearest one the carved name has been scraped away to raw splintered wood, as if with a knife; beside it a freshly dug grave, empty, its earth heaped neatly, waiting.
secret_3: the hall of Mara, goddess of winter and death, all of blue ice: rows of warriors frozen standing inside the ice; among them a grey-haired young man with a traveller's bag, half transparent like a ghost, and tall pale Mara in a white veil lifting his chin with two fingers, the way a mistress handles her dog.
secret_4: the throne hall of Koschei the Deathless, gold gone green and bones: on the armrest of the empty throne lies an open old leather book, and on its open pages is this same picture, the throne and the book, and in that book the picture again, smaller and smaller, endlessly.
secret_5: on the windswept crags of Buyan Island: a weary young traveller with a linen bag looks down at a massive rusted iron anchor chain stretching from the roots of the death oak deep into the abyss of the sea; in his open palm a small iron needle pulses with a faint amber heart-light, while behind him the shadow of an ancient crown looms in the fog.
buyan_1: a jagged granite island rising out of a pitch-black dead sea under a blood-red sky, thick freezing mist wrapping its razor cliffs, dead waves breaking without spray; high on the dark crags in the distance stands an ancient iron burial mound, and a small boat approaches the shore.
buyan_2: the sacred grove of Buyan: an enormous ancient dead oak tree whose roots claw into a colossal white glowing stone with carved runes; from beneath the stone run two bubbling springs, one steaming with faint white light and one dark as black glass; high above in the stormy sky a giant iron-feathered bird wheels.
